decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch within the firm’s established range that still had its own webpage in 2024, it reflects visible commitment and strategic fit, so management would continue backing it despite limited reported results.
This articulated dumper extends the core construction offer and remained prominently marketed in 2024, so sunk development effort and public commitment would favor persistence.

Because this mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the core range and was reduced from a dedicated page in 2023 to only a mention in 2024, management would see weaker strategic fit and declining public commitment, making withdrawal more likely.
The compact telescopic loader builds on the established business and kept a dedicated product page through 2024, which under an escalation-of-commitment logic supports continued market presence.
The material lift is close to the existing offer and the reported major order and longstanding popularity give management clear grounds to keep investing in it.

Despite being more distant from the traditional range, the firm has publicly committed to this product and its strong early operating result makes it easy for management to justify continuing with it.
